capabilities: capture expenses and income with quick transaction entry
track budgets, recurring bills and loan payments with due-date reminders
record net worth across accounts, investments and liabilities in multiple currencies
generate financial statements, cash-flow forecasts and savings-goal projections
produce monthly and annual review notes as Markdown
extras: Roadmap lists planned CSV import/export and other future features. Manual installation steps are documented alongside community-store install. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track spending, budgets, debts or net worth, so users must keep finances in outside apps or spreadsheets.

relations.evidence: Transactions are written with Dataview inline fields so they can be queried directly.

summary: Multi-currency personal finance tracker that records transactions, budgets, bills, debts, net worth and statements as plain files in the vault.
